classification.difficultyReason: Four substitution systems require choosing and rearranging an equation, carrying a fractional expression through substitution and checking fractional or signed solutions. Multi-step algebra is substantial but the required method is named.

content.prompt: Solve the simultaneous equations using the substitution method.

answer.worked:
From the second equation:
$$\begin{align*}2y&=7x-3\\y&=\frac{7x-3}{2}\end{align*}$$
Substitute into the first equation:
$$\begin{align*}3x+4\left(\frac{7x-3}{2}\right)&=11\\3x+14x-6&=11\\17x&=17\\x&=1\\y&=\frac{7(1)-3}{2}\\y&=2\end{align*}$$
Check: $3(1)+4(2)=11$ and $7(1)-2(2)=3$.

From the first equation:
$$\begin{align*}5x&=12+3y\\x&=\frac{12+3y}{5}\end{align*}$$
Substitute into the second equation, then multiply both sides by 5:
$$\begin{align*}2\left(\frac{12+3y}{5}\right)+5y&=11\\24+6y+25y&=55\\31y&=31\\y&=1\\x&=\frac{12+3(1)}{5}\\x&=3\end{align*}$$
Check: $5(3)-3(1)=12$ and $2(3)+5(1)=11$.

$a=\dfrac{11}{13},\ b=\dfrac{21}{13}$.

Make $a$ the subject, substitute to find $b$, then back-substitute.
answer.worked:
From the first equation:
$$\begin{align*}2a&=13-7b\\a&=\frac{13-7b}{2}\end{align*}$$
Substitute into the second equation, then multiply both sides by 2:
$$\begin{align*}3\left(\frac{13-7b}{2}\right)+4b&=9\\39-21b+8b&=18\\-13b&=-21\\b&=\frac{21}{13}\\a&=\frac{13-7(21/13)}{2}\\a&=\frac{11}{13}\end{align*}$$
Check:
$$\begin{align*}2\left(\frac{11}{13}\right)+7\left(\frac{21}{13}\right)&=13\\3\left(\frac{11}{13}\right)+4\left(\frac{21}{13}\right)&=9\end{align*}$$

answer.short:
$a=\dfrac78,\ b=-\dfrac{17}{8}$.

Make $a$ the subject, substitute to find $b$, then back-substitute.
answer.worked:
From the second equation:
$$\begin{align*}-2a&=11+6b\\a&=-\frac{11+6b}{2}\end{align*}$$
Substitute into the first equation, then multiply both sides by 2:
$$\begin{align*}7\left(-\frac{11+6b}{2}\right)+9b&=-13\\-77-42b+18b&=-26\\-24b&=51\\b&=-\frac{17}{8}\\a&=-\frac{11+6(-17/8)}{2}\\a&=\frac78\end{align*}$$
Check:
$$\begin{align*}7\left(\frac78\right)+9\left(-\frac{17}{8}\right)&=-13\\-2\left(\frac78\right)-6\left(-\frac{17}{8}\right)&=11\end{align*}$$
